name: Northeast Face Direct
approach: Mount Formidable is a deep objective on the Ptarmigan Traverse, reached from the Cascade Pass Trailhead at the end of the Cascade River Road. Take the maintained trail to Cascade Pass, then leave it and work across the Mixup flank on boot path, talus and snow, up the Cache Glacier to Cache Col, and down the far side to camp at Kool-Aid Lake. From the lake continue south past Art's Knoll and cross the Red Ledge, then follow a rough path over meadow, snow and talus and drop several hundred feet to the bench on the Middle Cascade Glacier between its two icefalls. Cross the bench to the foot of the Formidable Glacier below the northeast face. Allow a full day or more from the car to Kool-Aid Lake and about three hours from camp to the base of the face. The South Route from Yang Yang Lakes is the descent, not the approach. This is a multi-day glaciated objective that needs glacier travel skills.
descent_text: From the summit/north ridge, descend via class 3-4 scrambling with some rappels and snow traversal to the Spider-Formidable col (crossover saddle), then follow the Ptarmigan Traverse route back across the Middle Cascade Glacier and Red Ledge to the Kool-Aid Lake camp.

waypoints.name: Cascade Pass Trailhead
waypoints.note: End of Cascade River Road, 23 miles from Marblemount.
waypoints.directions: From SR 20 at Marblemount, cross the Skagit River bridge onto the Cascade River Road and follow it 23 miles to its end at the Cascade Pass trailhead, about 3,600 ft. The first third is paved and the rest is gravel, narrow and steep near the end; the upper road usually opens by late June or early July.

waypoints.name: Mount Formidable Summit
waypoints.note: Via Cascade Pass, the Ptarmigan Traverse, and the Middle/Formidable Glaciers; moderate rock to 5.6 with an AI2+ pitch in a hidden couloir.
waypoints.directions: Take the trail to Cascade Pass, then leave it across the Mixup flank, climb the Cache Glacier to Cache Col and descend to Kool-Aid Lake. Continue south across the Red Ledge, drop several hundred feet to the bench on the Middle Cascade Glacier, and cross to the Formidable Glacier. Climb it on its northern side, cross the moat into the hidden couloir, and follow the face to the north ridge and summit.
